name: Tokiwa Shizue
source:
She is the madam of a luxurious house near the supermarket where the main character works. Because she grew up in a rich family that is famous in her hometown, she is still arrogant even though she is over 40 years old. She always treats the protagonist with a haughty attitude. 

She has always had money to spare and has always gotten what she wanted, so once she wants something, she gets it. She even runs a fitness club to maintain her body shape and attractiveness as a woman. 

She is interested in the protagonist, who emits the aura of a man who can satisfy her sexual desires, and she even shoplifts on purpose to get his attention. However, the protagonist is initially uninterested in Shizue, who is out of his strike zone. 

When it comes to sex, she is the type of person who would rather take the initiative than have a man take the initiative. She tries to seduce the protagonist with her charms, but little by little, she herself becomes captivated by him.

Hobby: Exercising

"Here's my cell phone number, be sure to save it."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221005051345/https://www.guilty-soft.com/gg33/top_off.html]official site[/url]]
